code_audit_findings.description: Shaker.shake() previously bound tweens to the Shaker autoload without checking is_instance_valid(thing) on completion. Killing an enemy during a 2.0s Ultimate shake (e.g. adda_swap_health followed by Axe Attack) triggered freed-object errors. Fixed by binding shake tween to thing.create_tween() with validity guards.

Shaker.shake_loop() (triggered by Last Gasp Ultimate) created an infinite set_loops() tween on the global Shaker autoload instead of thing.create_tween(). When Player was freed on scene reload or battle cleanup without battle_over_screen_requested, Godot spammed 'Lambda capture at index 0 was freed' at 20Hz indefinitely. Fixed by binding shake_loop to thing.create_tween().set_loops().

EndTurnButton started enabled (disabled=false) during the initial 1.0s opening hand draw animation. Clicking End Turn during the opening draw launched Enemy Turn #1 concurrently with Player Turn #1, causing double signal connections on Golem actions, freed-card discard errors, and state race conditions. Fixed by initializing end_turn_button.disabled = true until player_hand_drawn.

Nuclear whiteout and fade tweens were bound to Player instead of Arena, risking an unresolving await if Player node was freed mid-cutscene (leaving battle_over_resolution_in_progress stuck true). Fixed by binding cutscene tweens to Arena.

Enemy nodes keep static scene names (GhostEnemy, GobEnemy, GolemEnemy) when EnemyStats are shuffled across the 4-enemy pool (including Wolf). Tools and future UI scripts must inspect enemy.stats.ai rather than node.name.
Stats.set_health() clamps health to max_health (45). Playing Blood Ritual above 23 HP caps healing at 45 while still applying -7 HP/turn bleed, making it a high-skill situational comeback card.
